title: Add photographer names to the photo credits
why: The three Unsplash photos are credited in the footer, but the photographers' names could not be read automatically, so each credit shows "[PLACEHOLDER] photographer".
steps:
1. Open each link in the footer credits (or the `unsplash` URLs in `content/demo.json`).
2. Read the photographer's name and check the photo is still free to use.
3. Add the names to `footer.photoAuthor` in `content/demo.json`, then run `node tools/render-pages.mjs`.

title: Confirm the real call-to-action address, prices and claims
why: `CTA_HREF` in `assets/js/main.js`, the prices, plan limits, the data-residency claim and the privacy and terms pages are placeholders.
steps:
1. Set `CTA_HREF` in `assets/js/main.js`.
2. Update `pricing` in `content/demo.json` and remove confirmed [PLACEHOLDER] / [نص تجريبي] marks.
3. Add the privacy and terms pages and link them in the footer.

title: Native Arabic review
why: All Arabic copy in `content/demo.json` is unreviewed.
steps:
1. Ask a native Arabic speaker to read `ar/index.html`.
2. Apply corrections in the `ar` object of `content/demo.json`, then run `node tools/render-pages.mjs`.
